capabilities: Route pasted and dropped images into a hidden .gallery folder
Browse images and subfolders as thumbnail cards in a gallery tab
Organize images into subfolders by dragging or right-click menu
Insert images from the gallery via a fuzzy-search command picker
View images in a fullscreen lightbox with zoom, pan, and favourites filtering
disambiguation: Not just an image viewer; it also reroutes pasted images into a hidden folder so they never appear in the file explorer.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README lists a BRAT installation path, so the plugin may not yet be in the community store.
motivation: The author hated having images clutter the note tree and found manually setting up attachment folders for every project annoying.
problem: Pasted images land in the vault root or a visible attachment folder, clogging the file explorer with unnamed PNG files over time.
summary: Image attachment manager that routes pasted and dropped images into a hidden .gallery/ folder and provides a gallery view to browse, organize, and insert them.
